en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front features an old industrial site with several large buildings, smokestacks, and piles of materials, probably wood or processed goods. There are some people visible in the foreground. The text includes geographic and sender information. The reverse side is formatted for sending and addresses, featuring Swedish script and design.
